query: SELECT eFUA_ID, eFUA_name, Cntry_ISO, UC_IDs, FUA_area, FUA_p_2015 FROM GHS_FUA_UCDB2015_GLOBE_R2019A_54009_1K_V1_0 ORDER BY eFUA_ID
inclusionRule: Every row in the frozen GHS-FUA R2019A V1.0 product; no additional population, GDP, geography, prior-sample or user-nomination filter.
limitations: 2015 modelled functional areas, not all settlements or 2026 observed commuting areas.
Population and area are candidate metadata, not CCI scores or ranking inputs.
No CCI scores, qualification, city crosswalk or polygon-overlap validation implied.
